name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix, domain 'animation', descriptor 'ani_decoder_target_width' accurately reflects the ANI frame-decoder per-row output byte length (row stride). No Ghidra address residue. Scalar uint16; 'target_width' conveys its scalar width-value role. Byte-identical to live Ghidra symbol.
purpose: ANI frame-decoder per-frame row stride: number of bytes each row chunk handler writes/copies/RLE-decodes into the destination row buffer.
logic_summary: First of the per-frame target-buffer triplet (target_width @0x52760, dst_buf @0x52762, src_buf @0x52766). Written once per frame by fd2_ani_decoder_set_target_buffer (16-bit store of the width parameter, MOV [0x52760],AX @ 0x36C84) before fd2_ani_decoder_decode_frame_bytes runs. Read by the three row chunk handlers -- fd2_ani_decoder_chunk_row_fill_byte (0x36B8A), _row_copy_literal (0x36BB2), _row_decode_rle (0x36BCE) -- as the byte count for the memset/memcpy/RLE-decode of one row into dst_buf.
element_semantics: Scalar uint16 row stride in bytes (line width of the blit destination); used directly as the length argument for row fill/copy/RLE operations.
notes: Mutable BSS confirmed by xrefs: exactly one WRITE (fd2_ani_decoder_set_target_buffer @ 0x36C84) and three READs (the row chunk handlers), so not const. Memory at 0x52760 is zero-initialized (bytes 00 00); non-zero bytes at +10 belong to the adjacent dispatch table at 0x5276A. Src comment (anidec.c lines 19-23) already accurate and precise -> kept unchanged. Ghidra PLATE comment present and consistent with refined understanding -> left untouched. Ghidra PRE comment also present (slightly older phrasing naming decode_frame_bytes as reader); not contradictory since that function dispatches to the row handlers, and PLATE is the authoritative data plate -> not modified per rules. No src edit made; only shard created.
